kuwait_towers.name: Kuwait Towers & Corniche
kuwait_towers.price_text: Tower entry fee varies; check on the day · Corniche walk free
kuwait_towers.hours: Towers usually open daily, morning to evening · Corniche always open
kuwait_towers.tip: Go near sunset for the best light on the bay. The waterfront walk is free and flat.

liberation_tower.name: Liberation Tower
liberation_tower.price_text: Viewing access is limited; check on the day
liberation_tower.tip: It is mainly a photo stop from outside. Do not plan your day around going up.

mubarakiya.name: Souk Al-Mubarakiya
mubarakiya.price_text: Free to enter · pay per item
mubarakiya.hours: Shops roughly late morning to evening · busiest after sunset
mubarakiya.tip: Come hungry in the evening for grilled food and sweets. Bargain politely in the older lanes.

al_hamra.name: Al Hamra Tower
al_hamra.price_text: Exterior free · mall inside free to enter
al_hamra.hours: Mall hours apply; check on the day
al_hamra.tip: Best seen from a distance at dusk. The shopping mall at its base is a handy cool stop.

seif_palace.name: Seif Palace
seif_palace.price_text: Not open to the public; view from outside
seif_palace.tip: This is a government palace, so you view it from the street only. Combine with the nearby souk.

tareq_rajab.name: Tareq Rajab Museum
tareq_rajab.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
tareq_rajab.hours: Usually closed Friday; check on the day
tareq_rajab.tip: A quiet, personal collection of Islamic art and jewellery. Allow an hour and check hours first.

avenues.name: The Avenues
avenues.price_text: Free to enter · pay per purchase
avenues.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–23:00 · check on the day
avenues.tip: It is huge, so pick a zone before you go in. Good for hot afternoons and family breaks.

qurain_martyrs.name: Al-Qurain Martyrs Museum
qurain_martyrs.price_text: Free or small fee; check on the day
qurain_martyrs.hours: Limited hours; check on the day
qurain_martyrs.tip: A moving site from the 1990 Gulf War. Confirm it is open before travelling out.

failaka.name: Failaka Archaeological Site
failaka.price_text: Ferry and site access vary; check on the day
failaka.hours: Ferry schedule and site hours vary; check ahead
failaka.tip: An island trip needs planning and a ferry booking. Go only if you have a spare day.

jaber_stadium.name: Jaber Al-Ahmad International Stadium
jaber_stadium.price_text: Entry only with an event ticket
jaber_stadium.tip: Visit only if you have a match ticket. Otherwise skip it.

kidzania.name: KidZania
kidzania.price_text: Ticket price varies by child and adult; check on the day
kidzania.hours: Daily, mall hours · check on the day
kidzania.tip: Best for children roughly 4–12. Book online and go early to avoid queues.

entertainment_city.name: Kuwait Entertainment City
entertainment_city.price_text: Park entry and rides priced separately; check on the day
entertainment_city.hours: Seasonal, mostly evenings · check on the day
entertainment_city.tip: A large family fun park, best in cooler months. Confirm it is open before you go.

qasr_al_ahmar.name: Qasr Al-Ahmar
qasr_al_ahmar.price_text: Exterior view; check on the day
qasr_al_ahmar.tip: A small historic building near the old town. Treat it as a short stop, not a main sight.

fish_market.name: Sharq Fish Market
fish_market.price_text: Free to enter · pay per item
fish_market.hours: Early morning to midday · check on the day
fish_market.tip: Go early morning for the freshest catch and the busiest scene.

marina_view.name: Marina Crescent waterfront
marina_view.tip: Walk the crescent at sunset for skyline views over the water.

salmiya_walk.name: Salmiya neighbourhood walk
salmiya_walk.tip: Wander the streets for cafes and shops. Evenings are livelier and cooler.

dhow_cruise.name: Dhow cruise on Kuwait Bay
dhow_cruise.price_text: Price varies by operator; check on the day
dhow_cruise.hours: Mostly evening departures · check on the day
dhow_cruise.tip: Book ahead and confirm departure point. Sunset trips are the most popular.

grand_mosque.name: Grand Mosque (State Mosque)
grand_mosque.hours: Outside prayer times; check on the day
grand_mosque.tip: Dress modestly and visit outside prayer times. Guided tours may need booking.

shaheed_park.name: Al Shaheed Park
shaheed_park.tip: A green escape in the city. Go in the evening when it cools down.

messilah_beach.name: Messilah beach area
messilah_beach.price_text: Public access varies; hotel beaches charge; check on the day
messilah_beach.tip: Many stretches are private hotel beaches. Confirm access and price before you go.
